review: Independent semantic review of frozen OOD-N04-B05 v2 proposal

styleAssessment.method: Whitespace-delimited token counts; advisory only, no threshold
styleAssessment.assessment: Nonblocking. The ten revised keys are concise but each names the policy owner and the adapter/policy boundary. Their longer distractors still state concrete, plausible alternative ownership models; the right choice is determined by the explicit scenario decision, not length alone. No word-count equality requirement is applied.

identityAssessment: Retaining existing question IDs is supported because the primary dependency-inversion decision is unchanged; the v2 changes refine option wording rather than change the learning objective.
scopeLimitations: This review does not accept other N04 units, source implementation, consumer behavior, native behavior, or full BIZQ-01.
